newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Early S.Africa rand, bonds stronger ahead May PPI.
newsitem.headline: Early S.Africa rand, bonds stronger ahead May PPI.

text.p: 0700 GMT - South African rand stronger in patchy early dealings. Bond yields lower as locals pick up stock.
* Rand last at 4.5525/5555 on dollar from 4.5600/5630 late Wednesday. Rand hit overnight high of 4.5655 bid.
* Dealers say market, especially offshore players, long dollars after Wednesday's late run and associated carry costs should encourage selling.
* Key R150 last at 14.220 from Wednesday's late level of 14.235 percent.
* Dealers say local interest helping benchmark loan but turnover slim. May producer price inflation figures, due 0900 GMT, seen positive for bonds.
* May PPI forecast to grow 0.8 pct from April, giving year on year rise of 8.4 percent.
* Offshore confidence in both markets still seen limited by recent DRI/McGraw-Hill report ranking South Africa as having the highest investment risk among world's 10 largest emerging markets.
